title: volcanoes
text: GVP publishes new database version roughly every month. rebuild package’s .rda files current release: volcanoes eruptions pulled GVP’s WFS endpoint refresh seconds. events scraped per-volcano pages via headless Chromium (chromote) takes hour first time; subsequent runs reuse local cache data-raw/cache/events/. title: Volcanic eruptions — eruptions
text: One row per eruption recorded Global Volcanism Program. eruption belongs single volcano (volcano_number) may comprise many events.

title: Volcanic eruptions — eruptions
text: tibble one row per eruption. Columns include: volcano_number Integer. GVP volcano identifier; joins volcanoes. volcano_name Character. eruption_number Integer. GVP unique eruption identifier; joins events. eruption_category Character. Confirmation status (e.g. "Confirmed Eruption", "Uncertain Eruption", "Discredited Eruption"). area_of_activity Character. Named vent sub-area within volcano, reported. vei Numeric. Volcanic Explosivity Index, 0–8. start_year, start_month, start_day Numeric. Eruption start date. end_year, end_month, end_day Numeric. Eruption end date, known. evidence_method_dating Character. Method used date eruption. latitude, longitude Numeric. WGS84 decimal degrees active vent. Modifier uncertainty columns raw GVP export dropped build, matching rfordatascience/tidytuesday 2020-05-12 layout.

title: Volcanic eruptions — eruptions
text: Smithsonian Institution, Global Volcanism Program. https://volcano.si.edu/search_eruption_results.cfm

title: Eruption events — events
text: One row per event observed eruption — example lava flow, pyroclastic surge, lahar, ash plume. Many events typically belong single eruption.

title: Eruption events — events
text: tibble one row per event. Columns include: volcano_number Integer. Joins volcanoes. volcano_name Character. eruption_number Integer. Joins eruptions. eruption_start_year Numeric. Start year parent eruption. event_number Integer. GVP unique event identifier. event_type Character. Event classification. event_remarks Character. Free-text notes GVP. event_date_year, event_date_month, event_date_day Integer. Date event observed.

title: Eruption events — events
text: Smithsonian Institution, Global Volcanism Program. https://volcano.si.edu/search_event_results.cfm

title: Holocene volcanoes — volcanoes
text: One row per volcano least one known Holocene eruption, sourced Smithsonian Institution's Global Volcanism Program "Volcanoes World" database.

title: Holocene volcanoes — volcanoes
text: tibble one row per volcano. Columns include: volcano_number Integer. GVP unique volcano identifier. volcano_name Character. Volcano name. primary_volcano_type Character. Morphological classification (e.g. stratovolcano, shield, caldera). last_eruption_year Numeric. Year recently confirmed eruption (negative values BCE years), NA volcanoes undated activity. country Character. Country containing volcano. region Character. GVP geographic region. subregion Character. GVP geographic subregion. latitude, longitude Numeric. WGS84 decimal degrees. elevation Numeric. Summit elevation meters sea level. tectonic_settings Character. Plate tectonic context crustal type. evidence_category Character. GVP evidence classification activity (e.g. "Eruption Observed", "Eruption Dated"). dominant_rock_type Character. Primary rock composition reported. Additional columns GVP export retained verbatim names standardized via janitor::make_clean_names().

title: volcanoes 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Three exported datasets — volcanoes, eruptions, events — built Smithsonian Institution Global Volcanism Program’s Volcanoes World database (snapshot 2026-05-03), following schema popularized rfordatascience/tidytuesday 2020-05-12 release. data-raw/build.R rebuilds snapshot current GVP release; volcanoes eruptions come GVP WFS endpoint, events scraped per-volcano pages local cache.
